task: Public lzma_index_dup() dropped the cached per-Stream Check bitmask (dest->checks), so lzma_index_checks() on a duplicated multi-Stream Index reports only the last Stream's Check type; single file src/liblzma/common/index.c, genuine correctness fault.
vuln_desc: Public lzma_index_dup() dropped the cached per-Stream Check bitmask (dest->checks), so lzma_index_checks() on a duplicated multi-Stream Index reports only the last Stream's Check type; single file src/liblzma/common/index.c, genuine correctness fault.
